QUOTE: "On failure, sets `failed: true` again, unless it is one of the three removal errors above, in which case the post is deleted." and "Retry is manual, one attempt per tap. Nothing re-sends in the background."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `retryFailedPost` makes one `client.createPost` call per tap, with no background resend and `retryLimit: 0` (no client-level retry). On failure it re-marks the post failed, or removes it for the same three errors.
